create_visualizer: create a PyPlotVisualizer instance with a Cameras object to rasterize 3D scenes into 2D images
plot_bones: plot skeleton bones onto the visualizer by projecting 3D bone endpoints to the 2D image plane
plot_mesh: plot a 3D mesh with vertices and faces onto the visualizer using front or back face culling mode
draw_image: render the visualizer canvas to a numpy array image and optionally display it with matplotlib
frontback_triangles: sort triangles into front-facing and back-facing groups using the cross-product winding test
